issues.legal_issue: A plaint cannot be rejected under Order 7 Rule 11(d) on the ground of res judicata when deciding the plea requires examination of pleadings, issues, and the decision in the former suit beyond the plaint’s statements.

A dismissal following the plaintiff’s failure to produce evidence, when the plaintiff was absent and no evidence had been led, does not constitute a decision on the merits under Order 17 Rule 3 of the Code of Civil Procedure.
An order closing proceedings without purporting to dismiss the suit either for default or on the merits is not a final decision that bars a later suit by res judicata.
